user.title: Connect the vacuum
user.description: Enter the robot's reserved IP address and current provisioning details. Home Assistant must be able to reach the robot on the local network.

reconfigure.title: Update the connection
reconfigure.description: After pairing again, update the IP address and current identifiers. The same vacuum remains in Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: The vacuum cannot be reached on the local network. Check its IP address and Home Assistant's connectivity.
error.invalid_auth: The local key was rejected. Copy the current provisioning details again.
error.timeout: The vacuum did not respond in time.
error.invalid_response: The vacuum responded, but its status is invalid.
error.unknown: Could not communicate with the vacuum.

clean_area.name: Clean zone
clean_area.description: Clean one saved zone. Provide its ID or name, not both. A forbidden zone cannot be cleaned.

area_id.name: Zone ID
area_id.description: Numeric zone ID in the catalog.

tag.name: Zone name
tag.description: The zone's tag field. It must identify exactly one zone.

clean_areas.name: Clean zones
clean_areas.description: Clean one or more saved zones in a single robot command. Every ID must resolve to one supported, non-forbidden zone.

area_ids.name: Zone IDs
area_ids.description: Ordered list of positive zone IDs from the current catalog.
